user_authorization: 2026-08-14 conversation: contract finalization and formal run explicitly authorized ('go')
scientific_question: Under strict observation-only training with identical filters, data, and budgets, does a causal history-conditioned transition matrix improve the fifteen-state global posterior over a learned history-free static matrix and a fixed matrix?
claim_boundary: Synthetic ideal-twin state-update evidence only. Passing establishes neither forecast value, real-basin performance, nor recovery of the true transition probabilities (the pilot showed gains can arise without probability recovery).

methods.fixed: frozen base matrix every day; no trainable parameters
methods.static: StaticTransitionNetwork, one learned constant matrix (9 parameters); zero-initialized, training is deterministic, trained once
methods.history: HistoryTransitionNetwork (GRUCell, 21 features from previous-day forcing, global posterior, mode probabilities); three initialization seeds

training.loss: one-step observation negative log evidence only; multi-lead flow weight 0.0; transition regularizer weights 0.0
training.checkpoint_rule: validation negative-log-evidence minimum; best state restored before any evaluation
training.truth_isolation: training functions accept ObservableAssimilationBatch only (forcing, observations, initial states, initial covariances); feature normalizer fitted from a fixed-matrix causal rollout on training observables

primary_endpoint.metric: per-block normalized RMSE of the global posterior over all scored states (each state divided by its evaluation-truth standard deviation; zero-variance snow states excluded and reported)
primary_endpoint.aggregation: history = per-block mean over the three initialization seeds
primary_endpoint.contrast: static minus history, paired by block
primary_endpoint.confidence: paired block bootstrap, 20000 draws, 97.5 percent two-sided interval (Bonferroni family of 2 with prespecified H18F)

threshold_rule.anchor: G = fixed minus static per-block RMSE, 95 percent paired bootstrap interval
threshold_rule.branch_A: if G point estimate > 0 and interval excludes zero: T = 0.5 * G point estimate
threshold_rule.pass: interval lower bound > 0 AND point estimate >= T

secondary_descriptive: posterior mode accuracy with 95 percent paired bootstrap

preflight_gates.causality: trained history network: day-k transition gradient with respect to observations from day k onward must be exactly zero, and positive for some earlier day

artifact_decision.global_posterior_covariance: diagonal saved for all evaluation blocks; full matrix saved for the first 40 blocks (audit subset)
artifact_decision.candidate_posterior_covariances: not saved (size); global-mixture identity is inherent to the filter computation and the verifier replays the fixed arm bit-exactly instead

checks: decisive metrics recomputed from saved arrays with identical operations and bootstrap seeds, compared exactly
fixed-arm full-batch replay from regenerated data, max absolute difference <= 1e-12 (same batch shape as the runner, per the H17R lesson)
verification.failure_terminal_state: run directory preserved, registry row updated to a hold status, no rerun under this identifier without new authorization

h18f_prespecification: H18F (evidence + multi-lead observed-flow loss) runs only if the H18 primary endpoint fails; both arms are always reported together; H18F cannot support the later independent forecast evidence layer
